events.note: Authored by an AI agent run (issue #98, parent #92). The AWS statement was read on 2026-10-03; synthetic values only; not independently reviewed. Opened as unresolved: no provider statement covers marker words inside a value other than the published literals.

Statement 'expectation' is recorded as unresolved: Whether a provider-shaped value whose body is the word EXAMPLE plus filler is a placeholder is not settled by any provider source; needs a provider statement or a project-policy decision with a named reviewer and dissent.

Decided 2026-10-04 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner), ADR 0019 item 5 (#98). This case decides its eight fixtures (two bases and six projections); the bare-word case stays unresolved. Question: Is a provider-shaped value whose body is the marker word EXAMPLE (an sk_test_ or AKIA value with an EXAMPLE body) a placeholder? Options: A: placeholder (must-not-flag). B: only the exact provider-published literal is exempt (must-flag). C: a closed vocabulary decides. D: keep unresolved. Decision: B for these values: only a literal a provider publishes is exempt, as aws-example-keys-one-character-off already holds. A provider-shaped value whose body is EXAMPLE has no provider statement and is must-flag. The bare words EXAMPLE and SAMPLE (16 fixtures) stay unresolved until a recorded vocabulary addition. Downstream comparisons record whether generic-assignment and personal-data detection were enabled. Reason: AWS publishes exact literals and Stripe's page is silent on example markers; the closed placeholder vocabulary of this repository exempts recognised spellings only, and a marker inside a body is not one. Project policy, not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The word EXAMPLE in a provider-shaped body is exactly how documentation writes a value that cannot be issued; flagging it makes every documentation snippet a must-flag input and teaches scanners to report placeholders.
events.reversingEvidence: A provider statement that it issues body-EXAMPLE values or that such values are examples, or a recorded vocabulary addition that covers them.
